name: Luca Martin
subject: TP3 deadline
body:
Hello Dr. Dupont,

Could you remind me of the deadline for TP3 on voting and reputation? Should we submit one ZIP per group on Moodle?

Thanks,
Luca

name: Lea Martin
subject: Demande de prolongation pour le TP2
body:
Bonjour Monsieur,

J'ai été malade toute la semaine dernière et je n'ai pas pu terminer le TP2 sur les agents BDI. Est-il possible d'avoir quelques jours de plus pour le rendu ? Je peux fournir un certificat médical.

Cordialement,
Léa

name: Yanis Robert
subject: My grade for TP1
body:
Good evening,

I did not receive my grade for the TP1 flocking assignment. Could you send it to me by email please?

Yanis Robert

name: Ines K.
subject: Office hours
body:
Hello,

I would like to ask some questions about the course before the exam. When and where are your office hours?

Best,
Ines

name: Tom Bernard
subject: Question sur l'examen final
body:
Bonjour,

A-t-on le droit à des notes pendant l'examen final du cours de SMA ? Et quels chapitres faut-il réviser ?

Merci,
Tom

name: Hugo Petit
subject: Late submission penalty
body:
Dear professor,

I am in your Multi-Agent Systems course. I submitted my practical work two days late because of a train strike. How many points will I lose?

Regards,
Hugo

name: Paul Lefevre
subject: Seminar talk next month
body:
Hi Martin,

Would you be willing to give a talk at the department seminar next month about your work on multi-agent systems? Let me know which dates suit you.

Cheers,
Paul

name: Claire Bernard
subject: Department meeting agenda
body:
Dear colleagues,

Please send me the points you would like to add to the agenda of the next department meeting before Friday.

Claire

name: Antoine Girard
subject: Co-supervising a master's internship
body:
Hello Martin,

I am a new lecturer in the department. Would you be interested in co-supervising a master's internship with me on reinforcement learning this spring?

Best regards,
Antoine

name: Sophie Dubois
subject: Échange de créneau de cours
body:
Bonjour Martin,

Serait-il possible d'échanger ton créneau du jeudi après-midi en salle C305 avec le mien du lundi ? J'ai un conflit avec une réunion de jury.

Merci d'avance,
Sophie

name: Lucas Moreau
subject: Replacing you for the Software Architecture class
body:
Hi Martin,

As discussed, I can teach the Software Architecture class on Thursday if you are away. Which chapter should I cover with the M1 students, and in which room is it?

Lucas

name: Human Resources Office
subject: Appointment for your annual review
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

Please let us know when you are available for an appointment with the HR office to complete your annual review form.

Kind regards,
Human Resources

name: Student Office
subject: Internship agreement waiting for your signature
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

An internship agreement (convention de stage) is waiting for your signature on the platform.

Best regards,
Student Office

name: Finance Department
subject: Missing receipts for your reimbursement
body:
Dear Sir,

Your travel reimbursement request from September cannot be processed: the original receipts are missing. Could you send them to our office?

Finance Department

name: Secrétariat
subject: Rapport d'activité annuel
body:
Bonjour,

Nous vous rappelons que le rapport d'activité annuel du département doit être transmis au secrétariat. Pouvez-vous nous confirmer la date d'envoi ?

Le secrétariat

name: Admissions
subject: Applications to review for the M2
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

Twelve applications for the M2 AI programme are waiting for your review in the admission platform. The committee meets in two weeks.

Regards,
Admissions Office

name: Marco Rossi
subject: D3.1 routing benchmark - input from WP2
body:
Dear Martin,

For deliverable D3.1 we need the description of the agent organisation model from WP2. Could you share a draft before our next monthly project meeting?

Ciao,
Marco

name: Sarah Klein
subject: SuperMASProject - AAMAS workshop paper
body:
Hi Martin,

Should we submit a joint paper to the AAMAS 2027 workshop with the first routing experiments? Who would be first author?

Best,
Sarah

name: Julia Schmidt
subject: Access to the SuperMAS experiment results
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

I am a master's student at TUM. Could you send me the unpublished results and the code of the SuperMASProject routing experiments for my thesis?

Kind regards,
Julia Schmidt

name: Claire Bernard
subject: Your project for the department newsletter
body:
Hi Martin,

For the department newsletter, could you write a short paragraph about the objectives of the SuperMASProject consortium and its work packages?

Thanks,
Claire

name: Lucas Moreau
subject: Premiers résultats des expériences de routage
body:
Bonjour Martin,

J'ai les premiers résultats des expériences sur les 3 modèles locaux. Peut-on en discuter avant la réunion de projet de décembre ?

Lucas

name: Tech Meetup
subject: Invitation to speak at our meetup
body:
Hello,

We organise a monthly tech meetup in Nice and would love to have you as a speaker. Are you interested?

The Tech Meetup team

subject: Hello
body: Are you available?

name: Marc Lambert
subject: Information about your work
body:
Dear Sir,

I read an article about AI assistants and would like to know more about what you do. Could we have a call?

Marc Lambert

name: Rédaction
subject: Demande d'interview
body:
Bonjour,

Nous préparons un article sur l'intelligence artificielle dans la région. Accepteriez-vous une courte interview téléphonique ?

La rédaction

name: Lucas Moreau
subject: Mission order for Lisbon
body:
Hi Martin,

I need to file my mission order for the Lisbon workshop. Can you sign the form as my supervisor, and will the project budget cover my travel?

Lucas

name: Luca Martin
subject: Internship in your research project
body:
Hello Dr. Dupont,

After your course I would be very interested in a research internship on multi-agent systems. Is there a possibility in your project next year?

Luca

name: Paul Lefevre
subject: Grades for the jury
body:
Hi Martin,

The student office asks for the MAS grades before the December jury. Have you already submitted them?

Paul

name: Hiro Tanaka
subject: Possible collaboration
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

I work on cooperative agents with small language models and I am interested in your research. Would you be open to a collaboration or a visit next year?

Best regards,
Hiro Tanaka

name: Student Office
subject: Question forwarded from a student
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

A student of the MAS course asks us in which room the final exam takes place and whether one A4 sheet is allowed. Could you answer directly to the student?

Student Office
